raw_commands:
{#-
  Barries Price Tag  ── 2.25" × 0.75" @ 203 DPI  (457 × 152 dots)
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Zone layout:
    y =   5 —  27  : item_name         (small, left aligned)
    y =  35 — 100  : Code 128 barcode  (with human-readable digits)
    y = 115 — 140  : MSRP price         (right aligned)
  Fields pulled:
    doc.item_name           → top line
    doc.custom_upc_helper   → barcode (synced from Item Barcode)
    doc.standard_rate       → MSRP price (from Standard Selling)
-#}
^XA
^PW457
^LL152
^CI28
^FO10,5^A0N,22,22^FB437,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.item_name or doc.item_code or "")[:32] }}^FS
{% if doc.custom_upc_helper %}
^BY2,2,55
^FO40,35^BCN,55,Y,N,N,N^FD{{ doc.custom_upc_helper }}^FS
{% endif %}
^FO280,120^A0N,24,24^FB170,1,0,R,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.standard_rate or 0) }}^FS
^XZ
name: Barries Price Tag
